Google Launches Pixel 11 Series with New AI Features and Tensor G6 Chip

Google has launched its new Pixel 11 smartphone series, including the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL, along with a foldable model. The devices are powered by Google's self-developed 2nm Tensor G6 silicon and feature upgraded cameras, brighter displays, and enhanced Gemini AI capabilities. Pricing for the series starts at $899, with specific Indian pricing also revealed. The launch event also introduced the Pixel Watch 5 and Pixel Tag.
